opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £10,000 to £250,000
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations, private owners of a heritage asset and partnerships. Organisations need a bank account, a governing document, and two or more members that are not related or living at the same address.
opportunities.summary: The National Lottery Heritage Fund's funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, from £10,000 to £250,000. Funds projects that value, care for and sustain heritage, guided by four investment principles (saving heritage, protecting the environment, inclusion/access/participation, organisational sustainability). There is no deadline; applications are accepted all year round.

opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £250,000 to £10million

amount.raw: grants from £250,000 to £10million (may consider over £10m for exceptional projects; max £5m under Heritage Enterprise)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations and partnerships led by a not-for-profit organisation. Organisations need a bank account, a governing document, and two or more members that are not related or living at the same address.
opportunities.summary: National Lottery Heritage Grants for all types of heritage projects in the UK, from £250,000 to £10million. Applicants must first submit an Expression of Interest, then go through development and delivery phases. Applications have quarterly deadlines. Guided by four investment principles (saving heritage, protecting the environment, inclusion/access/participation, organisational sustainability).
